mira-sec: Auditor wants a canonical evidence manifest that ties RBAC deltas, KMS provenance, and vuln tickets to control IDs. what's our minimal schema?
lee-ops: We ship evidence_manifest_v3.json as one-line-per-artifact. minimal fields: object_key, incident_id, control_id, artifact_type, collected_ts, collector_id, env, commit_hash.
auditor-liz: also need encryption proof: KMS key arn, key_policy_ref, last_rotation_ts, and whether envelope wrapping used. sha256 checksums and presigned urls are required.
mira-sec: ok. example entry (single line):
```
{"object_key":"evidence/2026-04-05/INC-678/terraform-pr-421.patch","incident_id":"INC-678","control_id":"AC-3","artifact_type":"terraform_diff","collected_ts":"2026-04-05T11:05:22Z","collector_id":"ci-exports","env":"prod","commit_hash":"9b2f3a","kms_key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/aa11","key_policy_ref":"docs/kms-policies/aa11-policy-v2","key_rotation_ts":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","envelope_wrapped":"true","envelope_key_id":"envkey-77","sha256":"sha256:2b7e...","presigned_url_expiry_days":"14","description":"rolebinding change from terraform PR #421","data_sensitivity":"prod_no_pii","vuln_ticket":"VULN-9001","vuln_severity":"low"}
```
lee-ops: note we add pr_url when available and reviewer_ids for RBAC changes.
auditor-liz: good. for SIEM evidence we prefer raw exports; screenshots okay only for quick context. include the SIEM query string in manifest.
export-bot: export-job exp-678-20260405 started: packaging 18 artifacts into s3://redwood-audit/INC-678/exp-678-20260405.zip
mira-sec: chain-of-custody will be a separate CSV with columns: artifact_key, exported_by, export_ts, ticket_ref, reason. include who decrypted (if any) and when.
auditor-liz: deliver a CSV crosswalk mapping control_id -> artifact_key + short description and whether artifact contains prod PII. sample windows: 30 days around incident + 1 rolling sample from previous 90 days.
lee-ops: will generate crosswalk.csv and a zipped bundle. presigned urls included in CSV. default presigned expiry 14 days unless you request longer.
auditor-liz: please include checksums, key policy doc links, and a note if HSM was used (hsm_token_ref).
mira-sec: timeline: we'll upload bundle and post link here when ready. leaving note to update evidence playbook with these fields.
export-bot: exp-678-20260405: completed. upload s3://redwood-audit/INC-678/exp-678-20260405.zip. CSV uploaded as crosswalk.csv in the bundle.
